Lets SteplerRSL tap buttons in the game for you, e.g. Battle on the main screen. It only performs taps and does not read your screen content.

Find SteplerRSL in Accessibility (on Xiaomi: Downloaded apps / Installed services, or search \"SteplerRSL\" in Settings) and turn it on. If it\'s restricted: App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings.
